categories.main_business_segments: Dalian Demaishi Precision Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive precision components manufacturing industry, focusing on precision shafts and precision cutting parts. Its product lines include components for vehicle window systems, powertrain systems, body and chassis systems, and industrial precision parts. The company serves both traditional fuel vehicles and new energy vehicles, including electric and hydrogen fuel cell vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as extrusion, rolling, grinding, milling, cutting, heat treatment, and precision inspection. It has developed proprietary techniques including worm gear milling, worm gear burnishing, one-way gear milling, automatic straightening, magnetic grinding, involute spline hard machining, and high-precision screw hard milling. Automation and digitalization are integral, with extensive use of MES, WMS, APS, PLM systems, IoT, and AI to enhance smart manufacturing and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Demaishi's key customers are global leading automotive parts suppliers such as Bosch, DENSO, Aisin Seiki, Valeo, Mahle, Marelli, Schaeffler, Toyota Industries, Brose, LG, and others. Its products are used by major automotive manufacturers including Tesla, BYD, Volkswagen, Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Toyota, Honda, and various Chinese new energy vehicle brands. The company serves both domestic and international automotive markets, with a focus on new energy vehicles and advanced automotive systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Dalian, Liaoning Province. Its products are exported to Europe, Asia, and the Americas, serving a global customer base. The company has established long-term cooperation with multinational automotive suppliers and serves markets in Europe, Japan, South Korea, North America, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Demaishi operates in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of precision components and parts that are supplied to first-tier automotive parts suppliers. It focuses on precision machining and assembly of critical automotive components, supporting both OEMs and tier-one suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in precision machining technologies and smart manufacturing. It invests significantly in R&D to develop advanced products for new energy vehicles, including electric motor shafts, electronic brake system components, and hydrogen fuel cell vehicle parts. Strategic priorities include digital transformation, intelligent factory development, and expanding into new fields such as robotics, medical devices, and nuclear power components. Collaboration with universities and research institutes is a key part of its R&D strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Demaishi generates revenue primarily through direct sales of precision automotive components and industrial precision parts. It operates on a make-to-order basis with a complete procurement, production, and sales system. Revenue is derived from product sales to automotive parts suppliers and industrial customers, both domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the precision shaft and precision cutting parts segment within the automotive parts industry. It competes with global automotive parts manufacturers and has established a strong reputation for quality and technological capability. Its competitive advantages include advanced manufacturing technology, stable product quality, strong brand recognition, and strategic partnerships with top-tier global automotive suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Demaishi reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 690 million, representing a 6.77% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 54 million, showing stable profitability. The company has demonstrated steady growth in revenue and cash flow, with ongoing investments in fixed assets and R&D. It maintains a solid asset base exceeding RMB 1 billion and continues to expand its market share in both domestic and international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Demaishi offers high-precision, high-quality automotive components with advanced manufacturing processes and strong technological innovation. Its products feature high accuracy, efficiency, and reliability, meeting stringent automotive industry standards. The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and ability to provide customized, multi-variety, non-standard precision parts. Its strong brand and long-term partnerships with leading global automotive suppliers further enhance its competitive positioning.
